description: Pittsburgh Street Centerline is a dataset listed in Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center (WPRDC), an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Pittsburgh. Overview Pittsburgh street centerlines data, in various formats. Mirrored from the City of Pittsburgh GIS Data Portal. Data dictionary Editor Tracking (createddate, createduser, lastediteddate, lastediteduser) Automatically recorded information indicating the creation date and user and the last modified date and user. From/To Street Name (fromstreet, tostreet) Where the street segment ends or begins. Coverage: Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. The portal files it under the publisher City of Pittsburgh. Its tags are _etl, centerlines, street centerlines. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-wprdc-portal.
